---
title: "Texas 2026 U.S. Senate forecast"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)

pub <- function(f) here::here("data", "published", f)
read_pub <- function(f) if (file.exists(pub(f))) read_csv(pub(f), show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
missing_note <- function(f) htmltools::p(sprintf("Not yet published: data/published/%s", f))
fmt_share <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)

headline <- read_pub("headline.csv")
track    <- read_pub("kalman_track.csv")
ledger   <- read_pub("poll_ledger.csv")
gates    <- read_pub("gates.csv")
regional <- read_pub("regional_projections.csv")

comp <- function(name) if (is.null(headline)) NULL else filter(headline, component == name)
combined     <- comp("combined")
fundamentals <- comp("fundamentals")

ungated <- if (is.null(gates)) NULL else filter(gates, status == "UNGATED")
ungated_for <- function(q) {
  if (is.null(ungated) || !nrow(ungated)) return(NULL)
  hits <- filter(ungated, affects == q)
  if (!nrow(hits)) NULL else paste("UNGATED:", paste(hits$gate, collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r}
list(
  value = if (is.null(combined)) "not published" else
    sprintf("%s ± %s", fmt_share(combined$mean), fmt_share(combined$sd)),
  color = "light"
)
```

## Gate notes {height="8%"}

```{r}
notes <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(c("combined", "poll", "fundamentals"), function(q) {
  n <- ungated_for(q)
  if (is.null(n)) NULL else sprintf("%s estimate: %s", q, sub("^UNGATED: ", "", n))
}))
if (is.null(gates)) missing_note("gates.csv") else if (!length(notes))
  htmltools::p("All gates affecting the headline components passed.") else
  htmltools::p(htmltools::strong("UNGATED "), paste(notes, collapse = "; "))
```

## Track and map {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Daily Kalman poll track, Talarico two-party share"
if (is.null(track)) missing_note("kalman_track.csv") else {
  track <- track |>
    select(-any_of("win_prob")) |>
    mutate(lo = mean - 1.96 * se, hi = mean + 1.96 * se)
  p <- plot_ly(track, x = ~date) |>
    add_ribbons(ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, name = "Poll track 95% band",
                fillcolor = "rgba(31,119,180,0.2)", line = list(width = 0)) |>
    add_lines(y = ~mean, name = "Poll track mean", line = list(color = "rgb(31,119,180)"))
  if (!is.null(fundamentals) && nrow(fundamentals)) {
    fb <- tibble(date = range(track$date),
                 lo = fundamentals$mean - 1.96 * fundamentals$sd,
                 hi = fundamentals$mean + 1.96 * fundamentals$sd)
    p <- p |> add_ribbons(data = fb, x = ~date, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi,
                          name = "Fundamentals prior 95% band",
                          fillcolor = "rgba(127,127,127,0.2)", line = list(width = 0))
  }
  p |> layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "Talarico two-party share", tickformat = ".0%"),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5,
                       line = list(dash = "dot", color = "grey")))
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| title: "Regional projections, Talarico two-party share"
geo_path <- pub("regions.geojson")
if (is.null(regional)) missing_note("regional_projections.csv") else
if (!file.exists(geo_path)) missing_note("regions.geojson") else {
  regions <- sf::st_read(geo_path, quiet = TRUE) |> select(region_id)
  map_df <- left_join(regions, regional, by = "region_id")
  stopifnot(!any(grepl("\\.(x|y)$", names(map_df))))
  lab_name <- if ("region_label" %in% names(map_df)) map_df$region_label else map_df$region_id
  labels <- sprintf("<strong>%s</strong><br/>Talarico two-party share: %s ± %s",
                    lab_name, fmt_share(map_df$mean), fmt_share(map_df$sd)) |>
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)
  pal <- colorNumeric("RdBu", domain = map_df$mean)
  leaflet(sf::st_transform(map_df, 4326)) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~pal(mean), fillOpacity = 0.75, weight = 0.6, color = "white",
                label = labels,
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333", bringToFront = TRUE)) |>
    addLegend(pal = pal, values = ~mean, title = "Talarico two-party share",
              labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = function(x) 100 * x))
}
```

